title: Antibiofilm and antivirulence potentials of iodinated fmoc-phenylalanine against Staphylococcus aureus.
authors: Faleye, Oluwatosin Oluwaseun; Lee, Jin-Hyung; Kim, Yong-Guy; Faleye, Olajide Sunday; Lee, Jintae
one_liner_zh: 该文研究碘化Fmoc-苯丙氨酸抗金黄色葡萄球菌生物膜与毒力，分子对接仅涉及AgrA蛋白-DNA结合位点，但核心是抗菌药物筛选，非TF-DNA互作建模，方法深度有限。
abstract: Staphylococcus aureus poses significant risks to public health due to its ability to form biofilm and produce virulence factors, contributing to the increase in antibiotic resistance and treatment complications. This emphasizes the urgent need for novel antimicrobial controls. Based on the premise that halogenation improves antimicrobial efficacy, this study investigated the ability of halogenated phenylalanine to effectively inhibit S. aureus biofilm formation and virulence activities. Among 29 halogenated compounds, Fmoc-4-iodo-phenylalanine (Fmoc-Iodo-Phe) displayed the highest antibiofilm effect against S. aureus, achieving 94.3 % reduction at 50 mug/mL. Microscopic studies confirmed its ability to prevent and disrupt mature biofilms. At 10 mug/mL, Fmoc-Iodo-Phe markedly inhibited virulence factors, such as cell surface hydrophobicity, hemolysin and slime production. It showed low propensity for resistance development and effectively inhibited biofilms formed by methicillin-resistant S. aureus (MRSA) and S. epidermidis, but was inactive against Gram-negative bacteria. Gene expression analysis complemented by molecular docking suggest that Fmoc-Iodo-Phe could target the AgrA quorum sensing cascade due to strong interactions with key residues at its DNA binding sites. Notably, it was non-cytotoxic in Caenorhabditis elegans model and satisfied drug-likeliness criteria based on ADMET prediction. Therefore, our findings position Fmoc-Iodo-Phe as a promising antimicrobial candidate against S. aureus infections, underscoring its potential as an alternative to traditional antibiotics.
abstract_zh: 金黄色葡萄球菌（Staphylococcus aureus）因其形成生物膜和产生毒力因子的能力，对公共卫生构成重大风险，导致抗生素耐药性增加和治疗并发症。这凸显了对新型抗菌控制手段的迫切需求。基于卤化可提高抗菌效力的前提，本研究探讨了卤化苯丙氨酸有效抑制金黄色葡萄球菌生物膜形成和毒力活性的能力。在29种卤化化合物中，Fmoc-4-碘-苯丙氨酸（Fmoc-Iodo-Phe）对金黄色葡萄球菌表现出最高的抗生物膜效果，在50微克/毫升浓度下实现94.3%的减少。显微镜研究证实了其预防和破坏成熟生物膜的能力。在10微克/毫升浓度下，Fmoc-Iodo-Phe显著抑制毒力因子，如细胞表面疏水性、溶血素和黏液产生。它显示出低耐药性发展倾向，并有效抑制耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA）和表皮葡萄球菌（S. epidermidis）形成的生物膜，但对革兰氏阴性菌无活性。基因表达分析结合分子对接（molecular docking）表明，Fmoc-Iodo-Phe可能通过与其DNA结合位点的关键残基强相互作用，靶向AgrA群体感应级联。值得注意的是，在秀丽隐杆线虫（Caenorhabditis elegans）模型中，它无细胞毒性，并满足基于ADMET预测的药物样性标准。因此，我们的研究结果将Fmoc-Iodo-Phe定位为对抗金黄色葡萄球菌感染的有前景的抗菌候选物，强调其作为传统抗生素替代品的潜力。
